copy.tagline: 将 iOS 和 Android 应用发布到应用商店
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将移动应用提交到 App Store 或 Google Play
copy.tagline_en: Publish iOS and Android apps to app stores
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to submit mobile apps to App Store or Google Play

howto.what: Claude 会指导你完成 iOS 和 Android 应用的商店发布流程，包括代码签名、版本号设置、构建配置以及提交审核。
howto.when: 当你需要将应用发布到 App Store 或 Google Play，或管理签名证书、版本号时触发。

say.text: 帮我配置 iOS 应用的签名证书和配置文件。
请指导我在 Google Play 上发布新版本。
say.note: Claude 会说明版本管理和提交流程。

say.text: 检查预部署清单并开始自动构建。
say.note: Claude 会列出检查项和构建步骤。

howto.what_en: Claude will guide you through the app store deployment process for iOS and Android, covering code signing, versioning, build configuration, and submission.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to publish apps to App Store or Google Play, or manage signing certificates and version numbers.

say_en.text: Help me configure iOS signing certificates and provisioning profiles.
Guide me through publishing a new version on Google Play.
say_en.note: Claude will explain version management and submission.

say_en.text: Check the pre-deployment checklist and start automated build.
say_en.note: Claude will list checks and build steps.
